description:
## Current delivery contract — user-approved two-outcome stack
Owner: PR B. One PR per complete outcome, NOT one PR per bead. Keep detailed beads and cohesive internal commits for tracking; consolidate existing draft foundations into their owning feature PR where practical. PR B stacks on independently usable PR A. Include owning PR documentation and validation there. This supersedes earlier per-bead/prerequisite PR instructions and historical comments. Closed foundation status is not outcome acceptance.
New-feature E2E requires explicit human UX approval in zaq-emb.32; no self-approval.

PR B pre-UX gate: verify Person-bound execution, fixed cursors, bounded cumulative refresh, canonical dedup, context acknowledgment/cursor advancement, revocation, busy/finalizing handling, ordered delivery and delayed timeout distinctions. Include Agent/Engine/Channels architecture and operational docs in B. Unit/integration/property regressions first, real internal paths, mock external transport/model/clock only; isolated suites and mix q. Validate B based on A without adding runtime prerequisites to A. No new-feature E2E until B human gate; no final approval claim here.
title: [zaq-emb.31] PR B integrated validation and documentation
